title: Are Female Carpenters like Blue Bananas? A Corpus Investigation of Occupation Gender Typicality

bias_targets.methodology: Information-theoretic corpus analysis comparing the frequency of gender-modifying adjectives (e.g., 'female carpenter', 'male nurse') in large datasets (Wikipedia and Pushshift.io Reddit) against real-world occupational gender distributions from U.S. Labor Statistics. The study also utilizes word embedding cosine similarities to measure perceived gender coding and conducts sentiment and offensiveness analysis on comments containing gendered occupation mentions.
